# analyzer

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/analyzer"
```

Package analyzer exposes the immutago go/analysis analyzer.

Marked structs may own only primitive values, arrays of immutable values, other marked structs, and the library's Slice and Map types with immutable arguments. Unmarked structs cannot store marked values or these collections. Pointer fields, interfaces, functions, channels, and native mutable collections cannot establish an immutability proof. Reflection and unsafe operations are unsupported. Unmarked generic fields must prove their constraints exclude immutable storage. There are no suppression directives.

Owned local values permit construction and field updates. Shared references permit reads; their loans end after the final required use on each control\-flow path. Writes to a borrowed whole owner are rejected. Value copies have independent storage. Package\-level immutable values are read\-only after declaration initialization. Protected references stay local or pass to direct, non\-escaping read\-only calls. Freeze calls consume exclusive native map and slice builders without copying. Builder aliases and later uses are rejected; Clone creates independent native storage. Dependency proof failures propagate to importing consumers.

## Variables

Analyzer checks immutable type obligations and reports unsupported aliasing and mutations.

```go
var Analyzer = &analysis.Analyzer{
    Name:      "immutago",
    Doc:       "prove immutability of marked structs and immutable collection elements",
    Run:       run,
    FactTypes: []analysis.Fact{new(invalidPackage)},
}
```
